quiz.question: What is Marta’s connection to Harlan?
quiz.explanation: Marta is Harlan’s nurse, which puts her at the center of the medication mystery.

quiz.question: What makes telling a lie especially difficult for Marta?
quiz.explanation: Marta cannot lie without vomiting, a trait that shapes both the investigation and its resolution.

quiz.question: Who inherits Harlan’s entire fortune and property?
quiz.explanation: Harlan leaves everything to Marta, shocking the Thrombey family.
evidence_markers: Marta is bequeathed his entire fortune and property

quiz.question: Which document appears in the blackmail note sent to Marta?
quiz.explanation: The note contains a partial copy of Harlan’s toxicology report.
evidence_markers: partial photocopy of Harlan's toxicology report

quiz.question: What helped Marta administer the right medicine despite the switched labels?
quiz.explanation: Her nursing experience lets her recognize the medicine by viscosity without reading the label.

quiz.question: Who secretly hired Benoit Blanc?
quiz.explanation: Ransom anonymously hires Blanc to entrap Marta after Harlan’s death is reported as suicide.

quiz.question: Why does Ransom burn down the medical examiner’s office?
options: To destroy evidence of Marta’s innocence
quiz.explanation: The toxicology evidence could clear Marta; Ransom burns the office to destroy it.
evidence_markers: burned down the medical examiner's office to destroy evidence of her innocence

quiz.question: What lie draws a confession out of Ransom?
quiz.explanation: Marta says Fran survived, prompting Ransom to admit his involvement in her overdose.

quiz.question: Why does Ransom’s last attack fail?
options: He grabs a retractable stage knife
quiz.explanation: The knife from Harlan’s collection is a harmless retractable stage prop.

quiz.question: Where is Marta in the final scene while the family gathers outside?
quiz.explanation: Marta stands on the balcony of her new mansion, holding Harlan’s coffee mug.

facts.title: A Radiohead title
facts.text: Rian Johnson borrowed the film’s title from Radiohead’s song of the same name. He thought it suited a murder mystery.
evidence_markers: film's name from the Radiohead song

facts.title: A mystery-book namesake
facts.text: Harlan Thrombey’s name came from Who Killed Harlowe Thrombey?, a 1981 Choose Your Own Adventure mystery.

facts.title: The mansion’s missing room
facts.text: Neither filming mansion had enough upstairs space for Harlan’s office. Production designer David Crank built the office and an adjoining hallway on soundstages.
evidence_markers: neither of which had sufficient space
David Crank constructed the office set

facts.title: A collector’s moving treasures
facts.text: A museum referred the prop team to a local restorer with a private collection of mechanical automata. Another collector transported and installed the pieces on set.
evidence_markers: transport the automata and install them

facts.title: A score recorded at Abbey Road
facts.text: Nathan Johnson recorded the Knives Out score with an orchestra at London’s Abbey Road Studios.
evidence_markers: Nathan recorded the Knives Out score with an orchestra at Abbey Road Studios
